answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The violet holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
